page.running_head: GRATIANUS, VALENTIN. II, THEOD. LIB. III. A.C.

main_text.p: PIIS. FELICIBUS, SEMPER. AUGUSTIS, BO-NO. R.P. NATIS. Romæ verò Theodosius æデ des 389 panarias, quas, qui adibant, per occultas infidias in priftina ad fervitutem adigebantur, evertit; & pœnas meretricum abrogavit.
Beda.In BRITANNIA quid acciderit, quartum Theodosii bellum oftendit. Maximo cæso, cum nemo eam defenderet, Scoti à Circio vento, & Pictones ab Aquilone eam invasere.
SCOTI Eugenio Rege occifo, Britannia 383 pulsi, in Scandiam abiere, ibidem XXVII annos exulavere.

GOTHI eiecto Athanarico, qui fe nunquam in Romanos tranfiturum juraverat, Alarico 381 fubftituere. Athanaricus Conftantinopolim venit, à Theodosio benigne exceptus eft, & Romanum Imperatorem tanquam DEum reverenum coluit.

Proper.Sub his etiam Imperatoribus LONGO-BARDI ab extremis Germaniæ finibus, Scandinavia diaque infula egreffi, & novarum fedium avidi, Ihoreâ & Ajone Ducibus, Vandalos primum vi- 379 cere; his defunctis, primum fibi Regem Agelmund 389 dum Ajonis F. creavere.
Circa hoc tempus floruere Magnus Anfo- nius, Gratiani præceptor, quem ifte in Confu- lem elegit: Ammianus Marcellinus fcriptor gra- vis, qui veteris Germaniæ fitum mirifice illuftra- vit.
main_text.head: SACRA.
main_text.p: ROMÆ fucceffit Damafo in Epifcopatu 387 Siricius, fed illo adhuc fedente Nazianzenus patientia & doctrinæ perfpicuitate Arrianorum turbas

page.notes: Marginal notes are small and partly cut by the binding; the readings above are best effort. Left-margin side notes include dates (389, 383, 381, 379) and catchwords (Beda, Proper). Show-through from the reverse is present.
